notes: Answer checks for scripts/ui-smoke.ts --check-answers on (default): PASS then means the result equals the set's answer key, not only that a query ran. Sample data only: each key is a file of the generator that wrote the set (git-ignored, under --answer-root, default sample-data): <answer-root>/<dataset folder>/<set>/_answer-key/<key>. A rule names a dataset, the item (an exact pack query id, or a crossask template label), the key file and comparisons. Comparison types: cell (one row: column = key path), columnSum (sum of a column over all rows = key path), rowsByKey (keyColumn -> valueColumn equals the object at the key path; or keyColumns joined with '/' -> values {column: amount|count}, each key entry an object of those columns; every entry and nothing else), figuresPresent (each key path's figure appears in some cell of the result, sign ignored: for model-written SQL, whose column names are not known in advance). unit: the key's unit, dollars (a number or '1234.56') or cents (integer); results are always dollars; amounts compare exactly to the cent. kind count: compare as a plain number. A key path is dotted (counts.remittances_eft). An item with no rule, or a set without the key file, is reported 'not checked'.
